title: macOS main CI hangs (silent bun test wedge) since the ca31e9ae promotion: code regression or runner image 20261013 to 20261026
description:
The macOS leg of main push CI (`lint · typecheck · test (macos-latest)`, bun 1.3.14 via .bun-version, run-hang-guarded.mjs --silence-seconds 120) went from green on every main push read back to 38025163174 (last green 619f02cf, run 39889231736, 2026-10-23, 7-10 min, no SILENT annotation) to RED on both main pushes after tonight's promotions: ca31e9ae (run 41165975631, plus its --failed rerun, job 124438724067) and 2cca01dd (run 41169408076, job 124443904878). Every attempt (6 passes over 3 job runs) went silent for 120s, was sampled and killed, and the single hang-retry also hung: "attempt 2 ALSO failed after the hang retry ... (LCLI-760)".

EVIDENCE (read by log, 2026-10-31). Hang points differ every pass, so it is NOT one hung test: test/check.test.ts after two different tests, test/release-workflow.test.ts after "every npm publish in release.yml stages under release-candidate, and nothing writes latest", test/agent-context-constitution.test.ts after the AC2 dedupe tests. The process sample shows bun's main thread in kevent64 with ~96% CPU and a defunct child (symbols stripped). No assertion failure anywhere. ubuntu, windows and docker e2e legs of the same runs are green. macOS never runs on a PR (ci.yml: PR matrix is ubuntu+windows), so no PR tested it.

TWO CANDIDATE CAUSES, not yet separated: (1) code regression in the 29 commits 619f02cf..ca31e9ae (LCLI-771 init TTY gate, LCLI-740/762 cache clear, LCLI-765 agents --check, LCLI-768 CI hardening); .bun-version is unchanged across the range. (2) The runner image changed: green run used macos-26-arm64 image 20261013.0424.1, red runs use 20261026.0455.2; same OS 26.6.2 (25G83) and same bun pin. Deciding experiment (leader-directed): workflow_dispatch of ci.yml on the OLD good SHA 619f02cf (branch diag/LCLI-760-macos-619f02cf, run 41170924075): hangs there => image; green => bisect 619f02cf..ca31e9ae with dispatches.

Not a gate for the paired 0.14.2 release decision on its own, but the runbook tags only a commit whose main CI matrix is green, so LCLI-775's metadata PR waits on this. LCLI-760 status is deliberately untouched.
implementationNotes: RESULT 2026-10-31T05:08Z: ci.yml workflow_dispatch on the OLD good SHA 619f02cf (branch diag/LCLI-760-macos-619f02cf, run 41170924075, macOS job 124448511855) FAILED the same way: both passes silent 120s, "attempt 2 ALSO failed after the hang retry". Runner image on that dispatch: macos-26-arm64 Version 20261026.0455.2 (green 619f02cf ran on 20261013.0424.1). Same OS 26.6.2, same bun 1.3.14. Conclusion: the hang follows the runner image, not the 619f02cf..ca31e9ae range; no bisect of our commits needed. Open: read the runner-images notes 20261013 to 20261026, leader decides the fix brief.
